finding: CdaChart empty-state text repeated the same explanation and made the empty chart read noisy in screenshots.
repair: CdaChart now renders the shared heading once and the empty body only shows the no-data message.

finding: Selection list titles and dense summary metadata could truncate or resist wrapping under long generated labels.
repair: SelectionListItem title copy and SummaryTile tooltip rows now use min-width and break-word rules; sandbox key/value rows wrap responsively.

finding: Mermaid SVGs could disappear after Blazor parent rerenders because the rendered SVG is owned by JavaScript interop.
repair: MermaidDiagram now checks for missing rendered SVGs, and mermaidDiagram.js installs a DOM guard that restores the last successful SVG markup if Blazor clears the viewport.

finding: The Mermaid Sankey gallery sample emitted invalid NaN SVG paths when Mermaid interpreted a CSV header as data.
repair: The Sankey source no longer includes the header row; the verifier requires every gallery example to produce a nonblank SVG without console errors.

finding: Mermaid parse failures left Mermaid's built-in fallback error SVG at the bottom of the page outside the wrapper.
repair: mermaidDiagram.js now removes Mermaid render artifacts on both success and failure, while the wrapper shows its own structured line, column, token, and expected-token diagnostics.
